verdict.rationale: Floot's own platform docs list built-in jobs that run on a schedule without a server to keep alive. This is a recurring-schedule capability, not a one-off action, so the core of the story is directly delivered. The evidence is a single line with no further detail. Missing for 10: documentation of schedule configuration (cron/interval syntax), job monitoring or management, whether the AI assistant/MCP can create schedules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Jobs that run on a schedule, without a server to keep alive.
